Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-interview debrief: Priyanka Das — recommendation and next steps

Thanks all for taking the panel yesterday. Short debrief: 
- Candidate: Priyanka Das (referral by Vivek)
- Interview summary: strong infra fundamentals, clear on tradeoffs, solid design for high-throughput KV caching. Communication was good; asked clarifying questions.
- Notes by interviewer:
  - Rishi: strong distributed systems mental model; would be comfortable pairing on infra work. Recommended move to on-site pairing for a coding check if we want to see implementation detail.
  - Karthik: liked the behavioral examples; alignment with cross-team collaboration looked good.
- Recommendation: advance to a short pairing exercise (2 hours remote / paid) or optionally a take-home; I prefer a 90–120 min paired coding session with one engineer and one hiring manager.

Marissa — can you confirm candidate availability and ownership for the pairing? Vivek — thanks again for the intro; will keep you posted.

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
